description.text: The fourth expansion pack of the Pocket Monsters Card Game, released in Japan on 21 November 1997 and built around Team Rocket. It was aimed at experienced players: every evolved Pokémon in it is a Dark Pokémon, with lower HP than usual but strong attacks, and most of its Trainers are Team Rocket's secret machines, made to get in the opponent's way. In English it became Team Rocket in April 2000, which added Dark Raichu as a secret card; Japan printed that card later, in Crossing the Ruins.
